requirements.requirement: Only explicit identity encoding, validated positive length, and matching EOF bytes may support determinate essential progress; invalid current representations remain indeterminate.
requirements.assessment: Static review and focused tests confirm no determinate progress before trusted matching EOF, including malformed final required response and unsupported headers. Retry recovery of a previously failed invalid attempt is tracked separately as STILL OPEN under RUNTIME-LIFECYCLE-CURRENT-ATTEMPT-RETRY.

requirements.requirement: Reset failed-attempt byte count and trust before emitting retry progress.
requirements.assessment: The retry replaces the active attempt entry before the retry event. The focused test verifies attempt 2 is indeterminate and has no loaded/total values. The sticky aggregate invalid flag is a distinct defect and is covered by F-01.

requirements.requirement: Preserve source GLB map flip convention, UV channel, wrap modes, transform, and isolated target state.
requirements.assessment: Implementation and focused tests cover source sampler/transform preservation and per-target texture isolation.

requirements.requirement: Optional-map registration rolls back visible materials and every quality registry atomically, disposes temporary derivatives once, preserves the base texture, and leaves unrelated shared-material users unchanged.
requirements.assessment: Focused test injects failure on a second target sharing the base material and checks rollback, unrelated user, registries, derivative disposal counts, and base map preservation.

requirements.requirement: WorldRuntime owns greeting timers; replacement cancels old callbacks and dispose clears synchronously.
requirements.assessment: The focused regression instantiates WorldRuntime, replaces the greeting, manually invokes a stale callback, checks the newer transition, and verifies synchronous timer cleanup on dispose.

requirements.requirement: Run retained suites, lint, typecheck, production build, and source-bound browser paths that exercise these corrections.
requirements.assessment: Maker evidence reports full unit, integration, lint, typecheck, production build, and three Chromium passes; independent focused changed-path tests passed. Independent full suites were not rerun. The production-browser paths reported by the maker exercise R3 loading/pause/watchdog behavior and do not directly cover R5 retry recovery, optional-map rollback, or greeting timer changes. Independent production build/browser execution could not be completed in this isolated audit harness.

requirements.requirement: A malformed final required body cannot make the aggregate determinate before EOF; matching EOF is required.
requirements.assessment: The focused final-required mismatch test passed and asserts no determinate event when the final required body mismatches at EOF.

requirements.requirement: Inject assignment failure after optional-map registration on a second mesh sharing the base material and prove rollback, cleanup, and base preservation.
requirements.assessment: Focused regression passes with explicit disposal counts and checks visible material, quality registries, unrelated user, derivatives, and original map.

requirements.requirement: Behaviorally test WorldRuntime timer replacement, stale callback rejection, newer transition retention, and synchronous dispose cleanup.
Required-session aggregate reflects current attempts only and excludes previous failed-attempt representation state.
requirements.assessment: Reproduction completed all three required current attempts with explicit identity, positive Content-Length 4, exact four-byte EOF, and successful parses. The aggregate still reported indeterminate because aggregateInvalid remained set from the failed compressed first attempt.

requirements.requirement: Bind the audit to the exact base/R3/R5 patches, all inputs and outputs, exact six-path allowlist, sequential apply, and replacement bytes.
requirements.assessment: All declared input/output hash and length checks passed. R3 outputs were verified before R5 application. R5 changed exactly six paths; six replacement files matched byte-for-byte; non-overlapping R3 outputs remained unchanged. Warning/error whitespace apply checks and diff check exited 0.

requirements.requirement: External provider, deployment/production, physical device, and assistive-technology acceptance.
requirements.reason: Explicitly outside the FINISH-08 local audit assignment; no such acceptance is claimed.
